question: restaurants inside building footprints
sql: SELECT p.names['primary'] AS place_name, b.names['primary'] AS building_name, b.height AS building_height_m FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' LIMIT 50;

question: fashion stores in bbox -9.1450 38.7080 -9.1350 38.7150
sql: SELECT names['primary'] AS name, confidence FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category = 'fashion_and_apparel_store' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.1450, 38.7080, -9.1350, 38.7150)) LIMIT 50;

question: buildings intersecting LINESTRING(-9.1435 38.7100, -9.1330 38.7145)
sql: SELECT id, names['primary'] AS name, class, height FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-9.1435 38.7100, -9.1330 38.7145)')) LIMIT 100;

question: historic sites within POLYGON((-9.2220 38.6900, -9.2220 38.7090, -9.1950 38.7090, -9.1950 38.6900, -9.2220 38.6900))
sql: SELECT names['primary'] AS name, taxonomy['primary'] AS site_type FROM lisbon_places WHERE taxonomy['primary'] = 'historic_site' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-9.2220 38.6900, -9.2220 38.7090, -9.1950 38.7090, -9.1950 38.6900, -9.2220 38.6900))')) LIMIT 50;

question: buildings touching schools
sql: SELECT a.id AS school_id, a.names['primary'] AS school_name, b.id AS neighbor_id, b.names['primary'] AS neighbor_name FROM lisbon_buildings a JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Touches(a.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE a.class = 'school' LIMIT 30;

question: buildings fully inside bbox -9.1450 38.7450 -9.1150 38.7650
sql: SELECT id, names['primary'] AS name, class, height FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Contains(ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.1450, 38.7450, -9.1150, 38.7650), geometry) LIMIT 50;
